entries.title: Packing and seals
entries.text: A green cord marks transit freight, but potters may reuse old cords. A cord alone does not establish undeclared goods. The tally weight includes the dry jar and its packing (the tare).

entries.title: Common bowls
entries.text: A standard nested stack contains ten common bowls and weighs two catties. An intact stack is counted by its stamped spacer; loose bowls must be counted separately.

entries.title: Resins
entries.text: White frankincense shows clear grains where it breaks. Red-grain frankincense has red crystals in a waxy, aromatic lump. Kiln pitch is dark, dull at the break, and smells smoky. Both frankincense grades are legal but must be declared by net weight.
